title: Kiritani Haruka — Someday, I'll Deliver〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for watching, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Stay tuned for our next stream! Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Phew. Nice work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That went very well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Everybody really seemed to enjoy your No Blushing - Smiling Staring Contest! segment, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I didn't expect everybody to like my idea so much.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Although, a certain someone kept giggling from the start and didn't even last a second.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-Because I can't stare right at Haruka like that and keep a straight face...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm getting the giggles just thinking about it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I understand completely. There were quite a few comments that even mentioned how you have such a lovely smile.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! Another person even said, You'd be able to make a crying baby cheer up and laugh!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's so true! Haruka's smile has the power to make anybody's heart race!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's almost too hard to believe that she used to have trouble smiling at all.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I read about it in an interview that she did for an article a while back, and mentioned how she had trouble smiling when she was little.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, is that true?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. It has to do with when I was really little, around the time I was in kindergarten or just starting elementary school...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I apparently had so much trouble with it that everyone else began calling me the girl who doesn't smile...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That sounds like the complete opposite of you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But this one idol changed all of that for you, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We can't get anything by you, can we, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Who? Which idol?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She wasn't on TV much, so she wasn't all that famous but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wow... And I kept touting how I knew so much about idols, but I've never heard of this person before.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I tried looking her up after I read Haruka's interview, but all I could find was her birthday and hometown.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wanna try telling us more about what this idol was like, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'd like to learn more too.
Especially since they turned your frown upside down, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks. I'll make sure to bring by one of her CDs next time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I have the one photo album that she released too, so I'd like you all to see that too. It's something I treasure quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You have her photo album? That's great!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I can't wait to see what you bring, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I hope you like them.
Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's see... I'm pretty sure I put that CD and album... Oh, here they are!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I still listen to these songs from time to time, but it's been so long since I last looked at this album...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And it's really more like a collection of vacation photos...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Some involve interacting with the locals, like having meals with them and such, while others capture children pulling pranks on them...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Everybody seems so happy too.
Their smiles are so beautiful...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(It's the same with each photo too.
Her smile is what's causing everybody around her to feel so much joy.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I went through a lot after I became an idol, but I met someone who's genuinely been touched by what I've been trying to do.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks to her, I'm able to keep going as an idol.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I wish to become an idol like you and give hope to someone, but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If only I'd debuted with ASRUN sooner, I might've been able to work with you on something.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, that would've been wishful thinking. Even just meeting you would've been enough.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks to you, I overcame whatever was causing me to not smile.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks to you, I was able to change.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I wish I had a chance to tell you that...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But it's time for bed...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? Did my phone just...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm not seeing any new messages, but the way it flashed seemed like...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, could it be...?
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Huh...? There's nobody here...
I thought it was Miku or one of the others calling me over, but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The stage is all lit up, but it's so quiet...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...? My phone flashed again... Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
There's something on the floor.
Is that...? A ball of light...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Did it fall from one of the gantries?
I should move it before someone...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?! S-So bright...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? Where am I...?!
